verdict:
**Not CLEAN** — a few real issues, all minor-to-moderate.

**Findings (severity order):**

1. **Duplicate "Terrain" control (confusing / possible bug).** There's a "Terrain" dock panel at the bottom-left (with "Sun & Shadow" beneath it) *and* a separate "Terrain" button in the bottom-center toolbar (next to Tape Measure / Excavate). Two same-named buttons in different places suggests a duplicated dock or leftover element — a new user won't know which controls the terrain.

2. **Duplicated keycap badge in the shortcuts modal (rendering glitch).** The "Brush mode" row shows a `1 — 7` keycap badge at both the start *and* the end of the wrapped line ("[1—7] Brush mode: 1 Raise • 2 Lower • 3 … [1—7]"). The right-hand badge looks like the row's key column repeating due to the text wrap — reads as a glitch.

3. **Possibly truncated keycaps.** In the "Arrows: move selected object" row, the arrow keycap cluster appears to cut off after "↑ ↓ ←" (the "→" seems clipped), and the row's closing parenthesis is hard to spot. Minor.

4. **Very tight bottom-of-canvas layout.** The sun-position slider row sits nearly flush against the bottom toolbar buttons (Tape Measure / Terrain / Excavate / Analyze / Innovate) — no overlap, but ~0–5px of breathing room; it reads as cluttered and risks overlap on a slightly longer string.

5. **Minor IA oddity.** "Garden Shed" is grouped under "Fences & Structures" — defensible ("structures"), but "Shed" under a "Fences" heading may briefly confuse users.

**Q2 (5-second comprehension):** Yes — the title, "ADD TO YOUR YARD" list, 3D canvas, and the Blocking-but-clear "Keyboard Shortcuts / Got it!" guide communicate the app's purpose immediately. The modal being open on load is acceptable since it's dismissible and labeled.

**Q3 (broken-looking):** Nothing visually broken; icons, toggle states (Basic active, Undo/Redo disabled), compass, "Daytime" pill, and status bar all render correctly. The only "glitch-looking" items are #2 and #3 above.
